critical_code_review_comments: All 11 backend endpoints working correctly: templates, sessions CRUD, step save/complete/skip, preflight, pause/resume, complete, dashboard-stats
Session list view shows stats cards (Total Sessions, In Progress, Completed, Avg Health) and session cards with progress visualization
Template selection dialog shows 4 templates with descriptions and estimated days
Wizard view has 8-step navigation (Company, Contacts, Asset, Contracts, Security, Monitoring, Documentation, Go Live)
Each step has Form/Notes tabs, Actions sidebar (Complete & Next, Save Draft, Skip Step), Navigate buttons, Session Info panel
Company Profile form has all required fields: company name, email, phone, website, address, city, state, zip, industry, employee count, service tier, timezone, business hours
Contacts & Access form supports multiple contacts with name, email, phone, job title, role, portal access, alert emails
Go Live step shows preflight checklist with critical/non-critical items and Complete Onboarding button
Health score calculation works correctly based on completed steps and preflight items
Audit log records all session actions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 57 complete - Client Onboarding Wizard (Enhanced) verified. Key navigation: /onboarding route. Backend endpoints: GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/templates (4 templates, 8 step definitions), POST/GET/DELETE /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions, PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/step/{step_key} (save/complete/skip), PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/preflight, PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/complete (with optional first_ticket), PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/pause (toggle), GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/dashboard-stats. Step keys: company_profile, contacts_access, asset_discovery, contracts_billing, security_compliance, monitoring_automation, documentation, go_live. MongoDB collection: onboarding_enhanced. Side effects: completing steps creates entities in clients, client_contacts, devices, contracts, tickets collections.

1_templates_endpoint.details: GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/templates returns 4 templates (small_office, mid_market, enterprise, break_fix) and 8 step definitions

2_create_session.details: POST /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions creates session with template, client_name, priority. Returns session with ID (OB-XXXXXX format), status=in_progress, current_step=1, 8 steps

3_list_sessions.details: GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions returns sessions array and stats (total, in_progress, completed, paused, avg_health)

4_get_session.details: GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id} returns session with health_score calculated

5_save_step.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/step/{key} with action=save saves step_data and notes without completing

6_complete_step.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/step/{key} with action=complete marks step completed, advances current_step, triggers side effects

7_skip_step.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/step/{key} with action=skip marks step skipped, advances current_step

8_preflight_checklist.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/preflight updates preflight checklist items, affects health_score

9_pause_resume.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/pause toggles status between paused and in_progress

10_complete_onboarding.details: PUT /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id}/complete marks session completed, optionally creates first ticket

11_delete_session.details: DELETE /api/onboarding-enhanced/sessions/{id} removes session, returns 404 for non-existent

12_dashboard_stats.details: GET /api/onboarding-enhanced/dashboard-stats returns total_sessions, in_progress, completed, paused, avg_completion_days, devices_onboarded, completion_rate, avg_health

13_frontend_session_list.details: Session list view shows stats cards, search, filter buttons (All, In Progress, Completed, Paused), session cards with progress bars

14_frontend_template_dialog.details: New Onboarding button opens template selection dialog with 4 templates, client name input, priority select, Start Onboarding button

15_frontend_wizard_view.details: Wizard view shows client name, session ID, health score, step navigation icons, progress bar, Form/Notes tabs, Actions sidebar, Navigate buttons, Session Info

16_frontend_step_navigation.details: Can navigate between steps using step icons at top, Previous/Next buttons in sidebar

17_frontend_step_completion.details: Complete & Next button completes step and auto-advances to next step

18_frontend_go_live.details: Go Live step shows preflight checklist with critical/non-critical items, first ticket option, Complete Onboarding button

mocked_apis.note: No APIs are mocked for this feature. All onboarding-enhanced endpoints use real MongoDB data.
